topic: The Pi-Collision Paradox: Why Bouncing Blocks Count Digits of Pi
target_audience: University students (Physics/Math) or curious high schoolers

sections.title: The Hook: A Paradoxical Counting Puzzle
lecture_lines: Tiny block collides with a massive block.
The number of bounces is surprisingly huge.
Mass ratios unlock the digits of Pi.

lecture_lines: Energy forms an ellipse in phase space.
Collisions are boundary reflections in a slice.
Trajectory arcs define the bounce count.

lecture_lines: Mass ratio shrinks the pie-slice angle.
The trajectory unrolls along a circular arc.
It physically computes digits of Pi.

Simple collisions map to deep numbers.
